places.name: Ischigualasto Provincial Park (Valley of the Moon, UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: UNESCO World Heritage site known for its otherworldly desert landscapes, unique geological formations (like 'The Mushroom', 'The Submarine'), and important paleontological discoveries (some of the oldest known dinosaur fossils). Requires guided tour circuit by vehicle.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary seasonally, check official website; entry only with guided vehicle convoy tour

places.place_tip: Located far from San Juan city (~4 hours drive). Must enter with own vehicle or hired transport as part of guided convoy. Bring sun protection, hat, water. Museum at entrance.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required for standard tour, but check website
places.name_english: Ischigualasto Provincial Park (Valley Of The Moon, UNESCO)
places.address: Parque Provincial Ischigualasto, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: San Juan Cathedral
places.ai_summary: Modern cathedral in San Juan city, rebuilt after the devastating 1944 earthquake destroyed the original colonial church. Known for its distinct modern architecture and bell tower (Campanile) offering city views.

opening_hours.notes: Check locally for specific opening/mass times; Campanile access times may differ

places.place_tip: Visit the Campanile (bell tower) for panoramic views of the city and surrounding mountains.
places.address: Bartolomé Mitre Oeste 25, J5400 San Juan, Argentina

places.name: Museo de la Memoria Urbana
places.ai_summary: Museum located in the former railway station building, dedicated to the history of San Juan city, with a particular focus on the devastating 1944 earthquake and the city's subsequent reconstruction.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can be very variable, confirm before visiting

places.place_tip: Provides important context about the 1944 earthquake's impact on San Juan's identity and urban landscape.
places.address: Santa Fe Oeste 451, J5400 San Juan, Argentina

places.name: Casa Natal de Sarmiento Museum
places.ai_summary: Birthplace and childhood home of Domingo Faustino Sarmiento, former Argentine president, writer, and educator. Now a national historic monument and museum showcasing his life, work, and period furniture.

opening_hours.notes: Check official website for exact hours, may close for siesta

places.place_tip: Important site for understanding Sarmiento's influence on Argentine education and politics. Located in San Juan city.
places.address: Sarmiento Sur 21, J5400 San Juan, Argentina

places.name: Parque Provincial El Leoncito
places.ai_summary: Provincial park known for its extremely clear, dry air, making it ideal for astronomical observatories (CASLEO and CESCO). Offers unique arid landscapes, wildlife (guanacos), petroglyphs, hiking, and stargazing opportunities (including observatory visits).

opening_hours.Monday: Park open daily; Observatory visit times vary (book ahead)
opening_hours.notes: Check official website for park access hours and observatory tour schedules/booking

places.place_tip: Located ~4 hours drive from San Juan city. Book observatory visits (daytime or nighttime) well in advance. Basic accommodation/camping available nearby. High altitude, dry climate.
places.cost: Paid (Park entrance fee + Observatory tour fee)
places.address: Parque Provincial El Leoncito, Calingasta Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Ruta del Vino San Juan
places.ai_summary: San Juan province is Argentina's second-largest wine-producing region, known for Syrah and Malbec, as well as fortified wines and brandy. Wineries ('bodegas') are clustered in valleys like Tulum, Zonda, and Pedernal, offering tours and tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking highly recommended for winery visits

places.place_tip: Focus on specific valleys based on interest (Tulum near city, Pedernal higher altitude). Book visits well in advance. Consider hiring a driver or joining a tour.
places.address: Various valleys (Tulum, Zonda, Pedernal), San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Cerro Mercedario Trek
places.ai_summary: Cerro Mercedario is one of the highest peaks in the Andes (6,720m), located in San Juan province. Climbing or trekking in this area requires serious mountaineering experience, expeditions, permits, and acclimatization.

opening_hours.notes: Requires planning, permits, and likely guided expedition

places.place_tip: Highly challenging mountaineering objective. Not for casual hikers. Requires significant preparation and logistical support.
places.address: Cordillera de la Ramada, Calingasta Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Ullum Dam
places.ai_summary: Dam and reservoir on the San Juan River, located near San Juan city. Popular local spot for water sports (windsurfing, kayaking, fishing), recreation, and enjoying the views. Several resorts and clubs line its shores.

opening_hours.notes: Public area; activity providers have own hours

places.place_tip: Located a short drive from San Juan city. Good for a quick escape and lakeside relaxation or activities.
places.address: Dique de Ullum, San Juan Province, Argentina

attribution.description: Muestra sintética de las principales características de la Ciudad de San Juan, Argentina.

places.name: Las Hornillas Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Natural thermal springs located near Barreal in the Calingasta Valley. Offers rustic outdoor pools with mineral-rich hot water and views of the Andes, including Mercedario.

opening_hours.notes: Basic facilities; access may depend on road/weather

places.place_tip: Located near Barreal, requires travel from San Juan city. Rustic experience focused on the natural hot springs.
places.address: Las Hornillas, near Barreal, Calingasta Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: El Leoncito Astronomical Observatory
places.ai_summary: Refers specifically to the two main observatories within El Leoncito Provincial Park: CASLEO (Complejo Astronómico El Leoncito) and CESCO (Estación Astronómica Carlos Ulrrico Cesco). Both offer guided tours (daytime and sometimes nighttime) showcasing their telescopes and astronomical research.

opening_hours.notes: Booking essential for both daytime and nighttime visits

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (clear nights essential for nighttime tours)
places.place_tip: Book tours well in advance via the respective observatory websites. Located within El Leoncito park, requires travel time. Night tours offer stargazing opportunities.
places.address: Parque Provincial El Leoncito, Calingasta Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Quebrada de Zonda
places.ai_summary: Gorge located just west of San Juan city, known for its scenic drive, rock formations, and microclimate. Features attractions like the 'Jardín de los Poetas' (Poets' Garden) and access to hiking areas.

opening_hours.notes: Public area; attractions within may have hours

places.place_tip: Easy scenic drive close to the city. Can experience the warm 'Zonda' wind here if it's blowing.
places.address: Quebrada de Zonda, Rivadavia Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Museo de Ciencias Naturales
places.ai_summary: Natural Science Museum in San Juan city, often housing paleontological exhibits (including dinosaur replicas relevant to Ischigualasto discoveries), regional geology, flora, and fauna displays.

opening_hours.notes: Confirm current hours before visiting

places.place_tip: Good place to learn more about the fossils found at Ischigualasto (Valley of the Moon).
places.address: Av. España Norte 501, J5400 San Juan, Argentina (Check current address)

places.name: Jáchal Windmill Museum
places.ai_summary: Unique museum in the town of Jáchal (north of San Juan city) featuring historic windmills ('Molinos Harineros') used for grinding grain, reflecting the agricultural history of the region. Includes the 'Molino de Sardiña' and 'Molino del Alto'.

opening_hours.notes: Confirm opening times before travelling to Jáchal

places.place_tip: Located in Jáchal town, requires a significant drive from San Juan city. Interesting insight into local history and technology.
places.address: Jáchal, San Juan Province, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo Prieto / Molinos Harineros de Jáchal

places.name: Tamam Huasi Trail
places.ai_summary: Likely refers to trails near or within the 'Tamberias Huazi Huarpe Community' area in Calingasta Department, focusing on Huarpe indigenous culture and history, possibly including petroglyphs or archaeological sites.

opening_hours.notes: Access may require coordination with community or local guides

places.place_tip: Requires specific local knowledge or guided visit to locate and understand cultural significance. Respect community protocols.
places.address: Near Calingasta / Tamberías, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Caucete Vineyards
places.ai_summary: Area east of San Juan city, part of the Tulum Valley wine region. While less known internationally than Mendoza, Caucete has wineries producing Syrah, Malbec, and other varieties, often with a focus on table wines or bulk production.

opening_hours.notes: Check specific wineries for visit availability

places.place_tip: Less tourist-focused than Mendoza's main regions. Research specific wineries offering visits and book in advance.
places.address: Caucete Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Camping Punta Negra
places.ai_summary: Likely refers to camping areas near the Dique Punta Negra, a dam and reservoir southwest of San Juan city on the San Juan River, upstream from Ullum. Offers opportunities for camping, fishing, water sports, and enjoying the reservoir scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Various private/public camping areas may exist

places.place_tip: Research specific campsites for facilities and booking requirements. Popular local recreation spot.
places.address: Near Dique Punta Negra, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Barreal Andes Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: The town of Barreal in the Calingasta Valley offers stunning, wide-open views of the snow-capped Cordillera de la Ramada range of the Andes, including Cerro Mercedario. Viewpoints exist in and around the town.

opening_hours.notes: Public viewpoints

places.best_time_to_visit: Clear days, especially morning/late afternoon light
places.place_tip: Barreal is a base for visiting El Leoncito Park. Enjoy the dramatic mountain backdrop from various points along the main road or viewpoints.
places.address: Barreal, Calingasta Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Calingasta Valley Route
places.ai_summary: Scenic route (RN149, RP406) through the Calingasta Valley, west of San Juan city. Runs parallel to the Andes (Cordillera Frontal), passing towns like Calingasta, Tamberías, and Barreal. Offers high-altitude desert landscapes, river views, and access to El Leoncito Park.

opening_hours.notes: Public roads; parts may be unpaved, check conditions

places.place_tip: Connects to RN40 further south or can be accessed from San Juan via RP12/RN149. Less traveled than some other scenic routes. Barreal is a key service town.
places.address: RN149 / RP406, Calingasta Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Iglesia Cave Paintings
places.ai_summary: Refers to potential rock art sites in the Iglesia Department (northwest San Juan province). This area has evidence of pre-Hispanic cultures, and petroglyphs or pictographs might exist, often requiring local guidance to find.

opening_hours.notes: Requires local guide/specific site information

places.place_tip: Finding specific rock art sites usually requires local expertise or guided tours focused on archaeology/history in the Iglesia region (e.g., near Rodeo or Las Flores).
places.address: Iglesia Department, San Juan Province, Argentina

places.name: Moon Valley Scenic Drive
places.ai_summary: Refers to the scenic driving circuit within Ischigualasto Provincial Park (Valle de la Luna). This mandatory guided convoy tour takes visitors past the park's major geological formations and paleontological sites.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary seasonally, check official website; entry only with guided vehicle convoy tour

places.place_tip: This is the standard way to visit Ischigualasto Park. Follow the guide vehicle and stop at designated points.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required, join next convoy
